optical_sar_insight.complementarySynthesis: SAR microwaves (5.4 GHz) successfully penetrated the 7.48% cloud/haze bank obscuring the optical frame, resolving underlying structural boundaries and ground geometry that were unidentifiable in VNIR. Dihedral radar wall-ground corner reflections (2628 spikes) pinpoint built structures regardless of optical shadow or illumination azimuth.
